*H. Ahmedov 1 and I. H. Duru 2, 1*

**Abstract.** Following the construction of the invariant integral and the scalar p roduct for the quantum Euclidean group Eq(2), we obtained the full matrix elements of its unitary irreducible representations from SUq(2) by contraction and then derived the Planscherel measure.
